Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.a1: Yes. Bring a valid license or a 1949 Geneva International Driving Permit. No license, no ride.
Faq.a2: A racing suit and helmet are included. Premium character costumes can be added at booking.
Faq.a3: We meet at おおきに道頓堀ビル in Kozu, near Namba / Dotonbori. About 5 min walk from Namba Station.
Faq.a4: Light rain: raincoats provided, we usually still go. Heavy rain or typhoon: free reschedule or full refund.
Faq.q5: How old do I need to be?
Faq.a5: Drivers must be 18 or older with a valid license. Children may ride as passengers if a seat is available.
Faq.q6: Do I need an International Driving Permit?
Faq.a6: It depends on where your license was issued. US and Japanese licenses are usually enough. Chinese and Korean licenses cannot be used on Japanese public roads without a 1949 Geneva IDP.
Faq.q7: Do you cancel when it rains?
Faq.a7: Light rain usually goes ahead, with raincoats. Heavy rain, typhoon, or official warnings: free reschedule or full refund. We reconfirm weather before departure.
Faq.q8: Are there height or weight limits?
Faq.a8: Drivers should be at least 145cm. Weight limits depend on the kart on the day. Staff will check the cockpit at check-in.
Faq.q9: Can I film with my phone while driving?
Faq.a9: Keep both hands on the wheel. Do not film while moving. Add a GoPro or pro photo follow if you want footage. Selfies are fine after you stop.
Faq.q10: How many people can go together?
Faq.a10: A slot is usually up to 4 karts. Bigger groups can split into back-to-back slots — message us and we will arrange it.

Help.title: Help
Help.licenseLead: You must show a valid license at check-in. Rules vary by country.
Help.us: United States: state driver license + 1949 Geneva IDP recommended.
Help.cn: China: Chinese license is not valid on Japanese public roads. Bring a 1949 Geneva IDP with the original license.
Help.kr: South Korea: a Korean license is not valid on Japanese public roads. Bring a 1949 Geneva IDP with the original license.
Help.jp: Japan: a valid Japanese license is accepted.
Help.uk: United Kingdom: photocard license. Confirm IDP needs for your issue date.
Help.eu: EU/EEA: national license. An IDP can help staff verify details.
Help.safetyBody: Closed-toe shoes, follow the lead kart, no racing, and stop if the guide signals. Helmets stay on while the kart is moving.
